evidence.quote: Salvatori is an award-winning Italian design company specialising in natural stone. From innovative textures for walls and floors to bathroom items and products for the home such as tables, lighting and accessories || Via Aurelia 395/E, 55047, Querceta LU Italy || Since 1946, Salvatori has worked closely with architects, designers and builders to provide not only practical support, but also inspiring new ways to work with stone
